res_planter.title: 花坛
res_planter.speaker: protagonist
res_planter.text: Hard soil, a hedge cut to a straight top, and a patch of wet concrete at the edge. The wet part has the shape of something that was lying down.
res_planter.repeat_text: The hedge, the hard soil, the shape in the wet concrete.

record.text: The concrete at the edge of the planter is wet in the shape of something lying down.

res_bench.title: 长椅
res_bench.speaker: protagonist
res_bench.text: A bench with its middle slat replaced by a different wood. Someone has swept the seat clean and left the sweepings under it.
res_bench.repeat_text: The odd slat, the clean seat, the pile underneath.

res_washing.title: 晾衣绳
res_washing.speaker: protagonist
res_washing.text: Four shirts and a towel on a line between two windows. The clothes do not move when the air does.
res_washing.repeat_text: Still four shirts and a towel, still not moving.

record.text: The washing between two windows does not move even when the air does.

res_stain.title: 墙上的污渍
res_stain.speaker: protagonist
res_stain.text: A dark stain on the render, roughly the shape of a hand. You came in past this wall. You are fairly sure the stain was on the other side of it.
res_stain.repeat_text: The stain is where you left it. You are less sure where that is.

record.text: You passed the same stain on the same wall twice, and you cannot say which side of the wall you were on.
